data.title: 久岛鸥 · 阁楼木地板上的终极宝藏
data.description: 阳光从阁楼天窗倾泻而下，照亮空气中漂浮的微尘。背心裙的排扣被悉数解开，鸥双膝微分跪坐在木地板上，眼角带着喜悦的泪花，把最珍贵的自己作为唯一的宝藏献出。
data.location: high attic loft with circular stained glass window and warm cedar floorboards
data.action: 背心裙的排扣被悉数解开，鸥双膝微分跪坐在木地板上，眼角带着喜悦的泪花
data.lighting: dazzling golden god-rays cutting through dust motes enveloping both in celestial warmth
data.promptProse: Inside a sun-drenched wooden attic where drifting dust motes gleam in beams from the skylight, Kamome kneels with her knees slightly parted and looks forward through shining, joyful tears.
data.animaCaption: Kneeling on the dusty wooden attic floor beneath a bright shaft of skylight sunbeams, she gazes warmly through happy tears as the buttons of her dark-green pinafore dress and ivory puff-sleeve blouse hang completely undone over her bare shoulders.
data.nsfwProse: Her dark forest-green pinafore dress and ivory puff-sleeve blouse are fully unbuttoned and parted open at the front, baring her shoulders and chest above white knee-high socks.
